item.title: Sankofa Awards to replace annual Miss Black EIU pageant
item.description: Miss Black EIU is cancelled this year due to low contestant interest, with only one student interested in competing, according to EIU Black Student Union adviser Ariel Taylor. item.title: Mattoon insurance agency celebrates 80th anniversary
item.description: The Gardner-Whitworth Insurance Agency in Mattoon is celebrating its 80th anniversary in 2026 after years of providing insurance to the area. When coming back from World War II, Kenneth and Ruth Gardner created Gardner Real Estate and Insurance. item.title: CHS boys’ basketball falls to Mattoon on senior night
item.description: A barrage of three pointers from Mattoon ballooned a 16-point halftime lead to as much as 29 in the third quarter, spoiling the Trojans’ senior night with Charleston falling 66-32 to Mattoon Tuesday at Baker Gym. Four three-pointers went through the net for Mattoon in the third quarter, with senior guard Lincoln Hayes leading the way by hitting two of the four. item.title: COLUMN: EIU’s first Black athlete, WWII hero deserves recognition
item.description: One of EIU’s most impactful famous alums has basically no recognition anywhere on campus. I think it’s time to change that. Charles Blakesly Hall was a student at what is now Eastern Illinois University from 1938 until he dropped to join the war effort in the spring of 1941. During the three years he was here, he was the first Black athlete at EIU where he played on the football and track teams, alongside being a pre-nursing...
